description: FirmLedger Pro. Open roles at approved FirmLedger companies, filtered by company and/or location and keyword: title, company, location, posted date and where to apply. Jobs on unapproved listings never appear.

company.description: Optional company (slug, exact name, FirmLedger ID or profile URL).

limit.description: limit. Integer or numeric string, clamped to 1–25.

offset.description: offset. Integer or numeric string, clamped to 0–10000.

query.description: Optional keyword in the job title or description.

name: list_jobs
title: List open jobs (Pro)
